operations.detail: Fresh canonical HEAD, unclaimed owner and absence of all five runtime outputs read back.
Published heartbeat and single_runner.lock snapshots compared for PID, root, time and generation-binding fields.
PID-reuse false-accept risk identified in the prior same-PID plus repo_root lock fallback.
Current daemon producer verified to emit matching instance_id, supervisor_started_at, lock process_start_time, lock scope, branch and updated_at fields.
Bound lock fallback now requires PID, repo_root, instance_id, process start time, lock freshness within 60 seconds, lock scope and canonical branch.
Helper receipt now records each bound-lock identity predicate and the heartbeat-to-lock update delta.

FF-only bootstrap repinned to preflight ea0d0da2c137c5e0b31592094e1a80d1ac0b49e1 and helper ced75abf0eb51712ad8284904655a23a69cbda30.
